function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Authenticates the customer identity using their account ID and verification PIN/code before disclosing any sensitive debt or account balance information.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer loan account (e.g. ACC-10928).

verification_code.description: The 4-digit verification code or birth year provided by the customer (e.g., 1234, 1995).

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Records a customer promise to pay (PTP) for a specific date and amount into the collections system.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer loan account.

ptp_date.description: Agreed payment date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-08-20).

amount.description: The monetary amount the customer promised to pay (e.g. 500.00).

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Sends a secure digital payment checkout link to the customer via SMS, WhatsApp, or BOTH, with their preferred payment election method preset.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer loan account.

channel.description: The communication channel to dispatch the payment link through.

payment_method.description: The customer's preferred payment election method to pre-fill the checkout link with.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Updates the final call outcome status and notes in the CRM/Collections system for reporting and follow-up.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer loan account.

notes.description: Summary notes describing the call discussion and borrower agreement/situation.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Creates an escalation ticket to transfer or route the customer to a human collections specialist.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer loan account.

reason.description: Reason for escalation (e.g. 'Financial Hardship', 'Disputed Loan Amount', 'Customer Requested Human Agent').

notes.description: Contextual details and history to assist the human agent.
